title: Workspace telemetry condition is derived from Home page loads, not the worker sampler
plan: FREE (plan irrelevant: sweep runs for every workspace)
expected: A 'Queue telemetry sampler delayed' condition is raised only when the real BullMQ sampler is stale, and recovers when it samples.

conditionWithFreshWorker.summary: The most recent queue telemetry snapshot for this workspace is older than the 30-minute window. The worker remains operational; the sampler may be delayed or paused.

observed.afterHomeNote: Queue telemetry sampler delayed: the source is below its threshold of 30 minutes. Resolved from positive observation, not from absence in a scan.
